ITEM 1 | Crispy, browned, ruffled strips of cooked meat with glossy reddish-brown edges and lighter translucent centers, layered in curled overlapping pieces across the upper right of the plate, roughly 3 mm thick, with visible rendered fat sheen and rippled texture; total spread about 12 x 9 cm, covering roughly 12% of the plate | 45

ITEM 2 | Loose, crumbly granular mass of tan-to-golden brown particles with darker toasted spots and tiny green flecks, dry-looking with no visible sauce, forming an irregular heap about 7 x 6 cm and 1.5 cm tall on the left-center of the plate, covering roughly 6% of the plate | 40

ITEM 3 | Whole ripe strawberries, bright red with white-tipped stems removed, some halved showing red flesh and pale core, glossy and moist, clustered in the lower right and center, about 2.5 cm each, covering roughly 10% of the plate | 60

ITEM 4 | Whole blackberries, dark purple-black, glossy with small drupelet bumps, slightly moist, scattered in the lower right and near the center, each about 1.5 cm, covering roughly 4% of the plate | 25

ITEM 5 | Whole blueberries, deep blue-purple with dusty bloom and small crown ends, smooth and firm, scattered in small groups around the right and center of the plate, each about 1 cm, covering roughly 3% of the plate | 15
